title: Inside Bhutan: The Himalayan Kingdom That Measures Happiness
description:
Discover life in Bhutan, a remote Himalayan kingdom hidden between India and China where ancient Buddhist traditions meet the modern digital age. Learn how this unique nation pioneered Gross National Happiness and why it faces the ultimate challenge of balancing economic development with cultural and environmental preservation.

Explore how isolated mountain villages, traditional architecture, sacred monasteries like Tiger's Nest, and untouched forests shape daily life in one of the world's most fascinating landscapes.

#Bhutan #Himalayas #GrossNationalHappiness #Documentary #ExtremeEarthLife
